statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The service is ordered to capture continuous rhythm data during symptomatic episodes
The service is ordered to guide further management and rule out significant conduction abnormalities
The patient's symptoms are coded as R00.2
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
SilverBridge Advantage requires precertification for such diagnostic monitoring services
